```{=html}
<h1 class="h1">Operating Systems</h1>
<p class="role">CS 301 · IIT Gandhinagar · Semester I, 2020–21</p>
<p class="lede" style="margin-top:18px">CS 301 covers processes and CPU scheduling, memory virtualisation, concurrency, and persistence through file systems, disks and RAID, following <i>Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces</i>. The course ran in a flipped format, with recorded lecture videos, class meetings on Zoom, weekly labs, and a zine made by each pair of students.</p>
<dl class="facts">
  <dt>Instructor</dt><dd><a href="https://nipunbatra.github.io">Prof. Nipun Batra</a></dd>
  <dt>Email</dt><dd><a href="mailto:nipun.batra@iitgn.ac.in">nipun.batra@iitgn.ac.in</a></dd>
  <dt>Lectures</dt><dd>Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday, 11:00 am–12:00 noon</dd>
  <dt>Labs</dt><dd>Thursday, 3:00–5:00 pm</dd>
  <dt>Teaching mode</dt><dd>Flipped classroom</dd>
  <dt>Google Classroom</dt><dd>Class code g27z27x</dd>
  <dt>Teaching assistants</dt><dd><a href="#people">5 TAs</a></dd>
  <dt>Textbook</dt><dd><a href="http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~remzi/OSTEP/">Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces</a></dd>
</dl>
```
:::

```{=html}
<section id="faq"><h2>Questions</h2>
<details class="q" id="format"><summary>How is the class run?</summary><p>In a flipped format. Lecture videos are on <a href="https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLftoLyLEwECB3NsNfQ1oxtt8IoBNRWcO5">YouTube</a>, and the class meetings on Zoom were recorded; both are linked from each class on the <a href="schedule.html">Lectures</a> page.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="policy"><summary>Where are the course policies?</summary><p>In the <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AeyF5Q01pR3o38UsgmknJgdrv-ZB6W9fJQ8hZrFdtfk/edit?usp=sharing">course FAQ document</a>, which covers the course policy and other questions.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="classroom"><summary>How do I join the Google Classroom?</summary><p>Use the class code <b>g27z27x</b>.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="zines"><summary>What is an OS zine?</summary><p>A poster on an operating-systems tool or idea, usually with a short video, made by a pair of students. The <a href="zine.html">Zines</a> page collects all 33.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="setup"><summary>What do I need for the labs?</summary><p>A Linux environment. An <a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jZVQRuomuYsuK5dkTyuVMxV4oNLFX8Hs/view">Ubuntu VirtualBox image</a> is provided, and the <a href="https://github.com/nipunbatra/os2020/tree/master/lectures/code">code used in classes</a> is on GitHub.</p></details>
</section>
```
